source: ZXNAME0000XZ makes the distinction even clearer because its persistent cache object is not ordinary full K/V. A serving engine can still need block allocation, scheduling, and memory management for ZXNAME0001XZ state, but the representation being managed is architecture-specific.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 使区别更加清晰，因为它的持久缓存对象不是普通的完整 K/V。服务引擎仍然需要 ZXNAME0001XZ 状态的块分配、调度和内存管理，但所管理的表示是特定于体系结构的。
